admission.justification: Real-message move-out in worktrees/group_messages.py and held-store settlement in cli/role_held_store.py together guarantee no needed report or waiting message is lost at deletion.

applicability: Terminal move-out of a task folder and closure of any seat holding waiting messages.
conditions: Regular files under a real workspace messages directory copy into canonical notes with collision-safe names before folder removal.
Closing a seat persists waiting message texts into heldStoreClosures on the launch receipt before unlinking the store.
exclusions: A messages symlink is removed without being followed; canonical message files are never deleted.

evidence: The Worker freeze report binds focused verification on this tree.

statement: Cleanup preserves reports and real message files in canonical notes, and closing a seat records its waiting messages with their exact text in the launch record.
title: Move-out saves reports and real messages; seat close records waiting text
